name: Transcode Downloader
description: PR TEST BUILD — Adds a quality-selection download button to Jellyfin item detail pages.
overview: Test build of pull request #1 (video/audio codec selection). Adds a 'Download (Transcode…)' entry to the More menu on every movie and episode detail page, now with an H.264/HEVC/AV1 + AAC/Opus codec picker driven by what this server's FFmpeg actually supports. Requires the File Transformation companion plugin (>= v2.2.1.0).

versions.changelog:
PR #1 test build — video and audio codec selection.

Adds a codec picker (H.264 / HEVC / AV1 and AAC / Opus) to the download dialog, backed by a new authenticated GET /TranscodeDownloader/Codecs endpoint that probes IMediaEncoder.SupportsEncoder and honours the admin's AllowHevcEncoding / AllowAv1Encoding toggles. Built from commit 6f7fb5688c9aca179ace77c7919c3b2ea7af6582.
